definitions.explanation: the process of combining and/or closing organizations, schools, facilities, or departments to streamline or reduce their number

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{統廃合|とうはいごう}が{進|すす}んでいる。
{少子化|しょうしか}で{小学校|しょうがっこう}を{統廃合|とうはいごう}することになった。
examples.english: Due to the declining birthrate, they decided to consolidate the elementary schools.

examples.japanese: {部署|ぶしょ}の{統廃合|とうはいごう}によって{人員|じんいん}が{削減|さくげん}された。
examples.english: Staff was reduced through the consolidation of departments.

notes:
{統廃合|とうはいごう} refers to combining and/or closing organizations to streamline.

COMPOSITION:
- {統|とう}: To unify, integrate
- {廃|はい}: To abolish, close
- {合|ごう}: To combine, merge

The term combines the concepts of merging ({統合|とうごう}) and abolishing ({廃止|はいし}).

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {学校|がっこう}の{統廃合|とうはいごう} (school consolidation - very common due to declining birthrate)
- {病院|びょういん}の{統廃合|とうはいごう} (hospital consolidation)
- {部署|ぶしょ}の{統廃合|とうはいごう} (department reorganization)
- {自治体|じちたい}の{統廃合|とうはいごう} (municipal mergers)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {統廃合|とうはいごう}を{進|すす}める (to promote consolidation)
- {統廃合|とうはいごう}が{進|すす}む (consolidation proceeds)
- {統廃合|とうはいごう}の{対象|たいしょう} (subject of consolidation)

CULTURAL CONTEXT:
In Japan, {学校|がっこう}の{統廃合|とうはいごう} is a significant issue as the declining birthrate leads to school closures and mergers, especially in rural areas.

RELATED TERMS:
- {再編|さいへん} (reorganization)
- {統合|とうごう} (integration, merger)
- {廃止|はいし} (abolition)
- {合併|がっぺい} (merger)

REGISTER: Formal. Common in administrative and news contexts.
